from pathlib import Path
import ast, hashlib, json, re
from typing import Any
import yaml
ROOT=Path("/tmp/macro-hk-ipo-f2-11085-20261112")
P=ROOT/"after/.github/ci/legacy-jobs.yml"
raw=P.read_bytes()
def blob(raw):return hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\0"+raw).hexdigest()
assert blob(raw)=="a56f09ffa08f4a29f3888b65fd616593f19f5091","Catalog preimage moved; reconcile before mutation"
text=raw.decode()
match=re.search(r"(?ms)^  conviction-profile:\n.*?(?=^  [A-Za-z0-9_-]+:\s*\n|\Z)",text)
assert match
block=match.group()
old_command="python -m pytest tests/test_ipo_prospectus_terms.py -q"
new_command="python -m pytest tests/test_ipo_prospectus_terms.py tests/test_ipo_hk_missing_copy.py tests/test_ipo_hk_evidence.py -q"
selector='      - "tests/test_ipo_prospectus_terms.py"\n'
additions = ["tests/test_ipo_hk_missing_copy.py", "tests/test_ipo_hk_evidence.py"] + [
    "engine/fundamental_forensics/"+name for name in ["__init__.py", "detectors.py", "filing_attestation.py",
        "filing_package.py", "ixbrl_extraction.py", "normalize.py", "pipeline.py", "sec_companyfacts.py"]]
assert block.count(old_command)==1 and block.count(selector)==1
changed=block.replace(old_command,new_command).replace(selector,selector+
    "".join('      - "'+path+'"\n' for path in additions))
updated=text[:match.start()]+changed+text[match.end():]
old=yaml.safe_load(text);new=yaml.safe_load(updated)
a=old["jobs"]["conviction-profile"];b=new["jobs"]["conviction-profile"]
assert len(a["paths"])==708 and len(b["paths"])==718
assert set(b["paths"])-set(a["paths"])==set(additions)
assert not set(a["paths"])-set(b["paths"])
assert {k:v for k,v in a.items() if k not in ["paths","steps"]}=={k:v for k,v in b.items() if k not in ["paths","steps"]}
assert len(a["steps"])==len(b["steps"])
assert sum(left!=right for left,right in zip(a["steps"],b["steps"]))==1
assert set(old["jobs"])==set(new["jobs"])
assert all(old["jobs"][key]==new["jobs"][key] for key in old["jobs"] if key!="conviction-profile")
assert {k:v for k,v in old.items() if k!="jobs"}=={k:v for k,v in new.items() if k!="jobs"}
runner=(ROOT/"ci-runner-qualified.py").read_bytes()
assert blob(runner)=="fdd099b87cf72e8221372ef55de95efa2b7d284e"
tree=ast.parse(runner)
nodes=[node for node in tree.body if
       (isinstance(node,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=="OBSERVED_COMMAND_SECONDS" for t in node.targets))
       or (isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name=="_job_weight")]
assert len(nodes)==2
ns={"Any":Any}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),"qualified-run_ci_pack.py","exec"),ns)
weights=(ns["_job_weight"]("conviction-profile",a),ns["_job_weight"]("conviction-profile",b))
assert weights==(53,57)
proof=json.loads((ROOT/"native-consumer-proof.json").read_text())
measured=set(proof["loaded_sources_after"])|{"templates/ipo.html.j2","tests/test_ipo_hk_missing_copy.py","tests/test_ipo_hk_evidence.py"}
uncovered=sorted(measured-set(b["paths"]))
assert not uncovered,uncovered
assert a["gate"]=="code" and a["scope"]=="exclusive" and b["if"]=="$"+"{{ false }}"
before_hash=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
P.write_text(updated)
assert P.read_text()==updated
record={"schema":"macro.hk_ipo_f2.ci_enrollment.v1","catalog_before_blob":blob(raw),"catalog_after_blob":blob(P.read_bytes()),
        "before_sha256":before_hash,"after_sha256":hashlib.sha256(P.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "owner":"conviction-profile","paths_before":708,"paths_after":718,"added_paths":sorted(set(b["paths"])-set(a["paths"])),
        "command_before":old_command,"command_after":new_command,"weight_before":weights[0],"weight_after":weights[1],
        "weight_proof":"Executed the exact original _job_weight and OBSERVED_COMMAND_SECONDS AST nodes from the qualified runner; not a full planner invocation.",
        "runner_blob":blob(runner),"all_other_owners_unchanged":len(old["jobs"])-1,
        "top_level_configuration_unchanged":True,"observed_source_and_literal_paths":sorted(measured),"uncovered":uncovered,
        "global_packing_ceilings_changed":False,"unrun_baseline_changed":False,
        "full_tree_contract_and_planner":"natural hosted CI required"}
(ROOT/"ci-enrollment-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k!="observed_source_and_literal_paths"},sort_keys=True))

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, socket, sys
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
stage,case=sys.argv[1:3]
SOURCE=ROOT/stage
WORK=ROOT/"native-cases"/(stage+"-"+case)
assert not WORK.exists(),"Reconcile an existing native case before replay"
WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
DATA=WORK/"data";shutil.copytree(ROOT/"retained/data",DATA)
os.chdir(SOURCE);sys.path.insert(0,str(SOURCE))
allowed={key:os.environ[key] for key in ("PATH","TMPDIR","LANG","LC_ALL") if key in os.environ}
os.environ.clear();os.environ.update(allowed)
network=[]
def blocked(*args,**kwargs):
    network.append("network")
    raise AssertionError("Network disabled in HK IPO retained-input proof")
socket.getaddrinfo=blocked;socket.create_connection=blocked
socket.socket.connect=blocked;socket.socket.connect_ex=blocked
import pandas as pd
from jinja2 import Environment
from lib import config
cfg=config.load();cfg["storage"]["data_dir"]=str(DATA)
cfg["storage"]["site_dir"]=str(WORK/"site")
cfg["run_status_file"]=str(WORK/"run_status.json")
cfg["storage"]["run_status_file"]=str(WORK/"run_status.json")
from engine import ipo_hk
from scripts import build_ipo
paths={"southbound":DATA/"china_connect/southbound.parquet",
       "hibor":DATA/"hkma/interbank_liquidity.parquet"}
regpath=DATA/"hk_regime/latest.json"
if case in ("series_older","series_future"):
    offset=-365 if case=="series_older" else 365
    for path in paths.values():
        frame=pd.read_parquet(path);frame.index=frame.index+pd.Timedelta(days=offset)
        frame.to_parquet(path)
elif case in ("regime_older","regime_future","regime_unknown","invalid_peg","invalid_regime"):
    reg=json.loads(regpath.read_text())
    if case in ("regime_older","regime_future"):
        reg["date"]=(pd.Timestamp(reg["date"])+pd.Timedelta(days=-365 if case=="regime_older" else 365)).date().isoformat()
    elif case=="regime_unknown":reg["date"]="today"
    elif case=="invalid_peg":reg["peg_state"]=["malformed"]
    else:reg=[]
    regpath.write_text(json.dumps(reg))
elif case in ("hibor_gap","bad_hibor","bad_southbound","zero","short_window","list_hibor"):
    for key,path in paths.items():
        frame=pd.read_parquet(path);col="net" if key=="southbound" else "hibor_1m"
        if case=="hibor_gap" and key=="hibor":frame.loc[frame.index[-5:],col]=float("nan")
        elif case=="bad_hibor" and key=="hibor":
            frame[col]=frame[col].astype("string");frame.loc[frame.index[-1],col]="not a rate"
        elif case=="bad_southbound" and key=="southbound":frame.loc[frame.index[-1],col]=float("inf")
        elif case=="zero":frame[col]=0.0
        elif case=="short_window" and key=="southbound":frame=frame.iloc[-19:].copy()
        elif case=="list_hibor" and key=="hibor":frame[col]=[[1.0] for _ in range(len(frame))]
        else:continue
        frame.to_parquet(path)
else:assert case=="native_control"
def hashes():return {str(p.relative_to(DATA)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in DATA.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
before=hashes()
raw=ipo_hk.hk_backdrop()
vm=build_ipo._hk_vm()
text=(SOURCE/"templates/ipo.html.j2").read_text()
start=text.index("    <!-- hong kong -->");end=text.index("    <!-- methodology",start)
macro=text[text.index("{% macro t("):]
macro=macro[:macro.index("{%- endmacro %}")+len("{%- endmacro %}")]
state=next(line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("{% set STATEW ="))
html=Environment(autoescape=True).from_string(macro+"\n"+state+"\n"+text[start:end]).render(hk=vm)
(WORK/"hk.html").write_text(html)
assert hashes()==before and not network
assert raw["available"] and vm["available"] and ipo_hk.SCORED is False
loaded={}
for name,module in list(sys.modules.items()):
    filename=getattr(module,"__file__",None)
    if not filename:continue
    path=Path(filename).resolve()
    try:rel=str(path.relative_to(SOURCE.resolve()))
    except ValueError:continue
    if path.is_file():
        data=path.read_bytes()
        loaded[rel]={"bytes":len(data),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
                    "blob":hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(data)).encode()+b"\0"+data).hexdigest()}
input_shape={}
for key,path in paths.items():
    frame=pd.read_parquet(path)
    input_shape[key]={"rows":len(frame),"first_date":str(frame.index[0]),"last_date":str(frame.index[-1])}
receipt={"stage":stage,"case":case,"raw":raw,"vm":vm,"html_bytes":len(html.encode()),
         "html_sha256":hashlib.sha256(html.encode()).hexdigest(),"input_hashes":before,
         "input_shape":input_shape,"input_unchanged":hashes()==before,"network_attempts":network,
         "loaded_sources":loaded,"consumer":"real Parquet/JSON -> unchanged store -> full engine -> actual imported VM -> native t macro, STATEW and bilingual HK section",
         "limits":{"full_page_build":False,"browser":False,"live_provider":False,"production":False,"scoring":False}}
encoded=(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n").encode()
(WORK/"receipt.json").write_bytes(encoded)
print(json.dumps({"case":case,"stage":stage,"n_legs":raw["n_legs"],"verdict":raw["verdict"],
                  "missing":raw["missing_legs"],"receipt_sha256":hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),
                  "html_sha256":receipt["html_sha256"],"loaded_sources":len(loaded)},sort_keys=True))

from pathlib import Path
import concurrent.futures, hashlib, json, shutil, subprocess
ROOT=Path("/tmp/macro-hk-ipo-f2-11085-20261112")
PY="/tmp/macro-ivspread11080-proof-20261111/native-env/bin/python"
assert not (ROOT/"red").exists(),"Reconcile existing red proof before replay"
manifest=json.loads((ROOT/"input-manifest.json").read_text())
for stage in ("before","after"):
    for path in [*manifest["owning_suite_literal_inputs"],*manifest["retained_inputs"]]:
        source=ROOT/"owning-inputs"/path.removeprefix("data/")
        dest=ROOT/stage/path
        assert not dest.exists()
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(source,dest)
for name in ["tests-after.json","tests-after.log"]:
    shutil.copyfile(ROOT/name,ROOT/name.replace("-after","-after-attempt2"))
shutil.copytree(ROOT/"before",ROOT/"red",ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__",".pytest_cache"))
for path in ["tests/test_ipo_hk_missing_copy.py","tests/test_ipo_hk_evidence.py"]:
    shutil.copyfile(ROOT/"after"/path,ROOT/"red"/path)
def run(stage):
    log=ROOT/("tests-"+stage+".log")
    with log.open("w") as out:
        p=subprocess.run([PY,str(ROOT/"run_test_proof.py"),stage],stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    result=json.loads((ROOT/("tests-"+stage+".json")).read_text())
    result["failed_count"]=len(result["failed"]);result["failed"]=result["failed"][:5]
    result["process_exit_code"]=p.returncode
    return result
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
    results=list(pool.map(run,["after","red"]))
print(json.dumps({"results":results},sort_keys=True))
assert results[0]["exit_code"]==0 and results[0]["failed_count"]==0
assert results[1]["exit_code"]==1 and results[1]["failed_count"]>0
assert all(not x["network_attempts"] and not x["skipped"] and not x["collection_errors"] for x in results)

from pathlib import Path
import ast, concurrent.futures, hashlib, json, subprocess
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PY="/tmp/macro-ivspread11080-proof-20261111/native-env/bin/python"
cases=["native_control","series_older","series_future","regime_older","regime_future","hibor_gap",
       "bad_hibor","bad_southbound","zero","short_window","invalid_peg","invalid_regime","regime_unknown","list_hibor"]
jobs=[("before","native_control")]+[("after",case) for case in cases]
def run(job):
    stage,case=job
    log=ROOT/("native-"+stage+"-"+case+".log")
    with log.open("w") as out:
        result=subprocess.run([PY,str(ROOT/"native_case.py"),stage,case],stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert result.returncode==0,(stage,case,result.returncode,log.read_text()[-2000:])
    return json.loads((ROOT/"native-cases"/(stage+"-"+case)/"receipt.json").read_text())
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:receipts=list(pool.map(run,jobs))
original=receipts[0];by_case={r["case"]:r for r in receipts[1:]};native=by_case["native_control"]
def legacy(raw):return {k:v for k,v in raw.items() if k!="coverage"}
assert legacy(native["raw"])==original["raw"]
def legacy_vm(vm):
    out={k:v for k,v in vm.items() if k not in ("coverage_en","coverage_zh","excluded_evidence")}
    out["legs"]=[{k:v for k,v in leg.items() if k not in ("evidence_en","evidence_zh")} for leg in vm["legs"]]
    return out
assert legacy_vm(native["vm"])==original["vm"]
assert native["raw"]["n_legs"]==4 and native["raw"]["verdict"]=="poor" and not native["raw"]["missing_legs"]
assert native["input_shape"]["southbound"]["rows"]==2749 and native["input_shape"]["hibor"]["rows"]==6367
for case in ("series_older","series_future","regime_older","regime_future","regime_unknown"):
    assert by_case[case]["raw"]["legs"]==native["raw"]["legs"]
    assert by_case[case]["raw"]["verdict"]==native["raw"]["verdict"]
    assert by_case[case]["html_sha256"]!=native["html_sha256"]
for case,key in [("bad_hibor","hibor"),("bad_southbound","southbound"),("invalid_peg","peg"),("short_window","southbound"),("list_hibor","hibor")]:
    result=by_case[case]
    assert result["raw"]["missing_legs"]==[key]
    assert result["raw"]["legs"]==[x for x in native["raw"]["legs"] if x["key"]!=key]
assert by_case["invalid_regime"]["raw"]["missing_legs"]==["peg","risk"]
assert by_case["invalid_regime"]["raw"]["low_confidence"] is True
zero={x["key"]:x for x in by_case["zero"]["raw"]["legs"]}
assert zero["southbound"]["value"]==0 and zero["southbound"]["state"]=="neutral"
assert zero["hibor"]["value"]==0.0 and zero["hibor"]["state"]=="constructive"
assert by_case["hibor_gap"]["raw"]["coverage"]["hibor"]["trailing_missing"]==5
def defs(stage):
    tree=ast.parse((ROOT/stage/"scripts/build_ipo.py").read_text())
    return {n.name:ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
old,new=defs("before"),defs("after")
unchanged=[name for name in old if name!="_hk_vm" and old[name]==new.get(name)]
assert len(unchanged)==len(old)-1
def outside(stage):
    text=(ROOT/stage/"templates/ipo.html.j2").read_text()
    start=text.index("    <!-- hong kong -->");end=text.index("    <!-- methodology",start)
    return text[:start],text[end:]
assert outside("before")==outside("after")
common_sources=native["loaded_sources"]
for r in receipts:
    if r["stage"]=="after":assert r["loaded_sources"]==common_sources
    r.pop("loaded_sources")
result={"schema":"macro.hk_ipo_f2.native_consumer.v1","native_parity":{"legacy_engine_exact":True,"legacy_vm_exact":True,
        "native_rows":{"southbound":2749,"hibor":6367},"verdict":"poor","legs":4},
        "consumer_cases":len(receipts),"after_cases":cases,"receipts":receipts,"loaded_sources_after":common_sources,
        "unchanged_builder_functions":unchanged,"template_outside_hk_exact":True,
        "source_case_harness_sha256":hashlib.sha256((ROOT/"native_case.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "source_driver_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "limits":{"full_page_build":False,"browser":False,"live_provider":False,"production":False,"scoring":False}}
raw=(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n").encode()
(ROOT/"native-consumer-proof.json").write_bytes(raw)
print(json.dumps({"passed":True,"cases":len(receipts),"native_parity":result["native_parity"],
                  "unchanged_builder_functions":len(unchanged),"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, socket, sys, time
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
stage=sys.argv[1]
SOURCE=ROOT/stage
assert stage in ("after","red")
os.chdir(SOURCE); sys.path.insert(0,str(SOURCE))
allowed={key:os.environ[key] for key in ("PATH","TMPDIR","LANG","LC_ALL") if key in os.environ}
os.environ.clear();os.environ.update(allowed)
os.environ["PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD"]="1"
os.environ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"]="1"
attempts=[]
def blocked(*args,**kwargs):
    attempts.append("network")
    raise AssertionError("Network is disabled for the HK IPO native proof.")
socket.getaddrinfo=blocked
socket.create_connection=blocked
socket.socket.connect=blocked
socket.socket.connect_ex=blocked
from lib import config
cfg=config.load()
cfg["storage"]["data_dir"]=str(ROOT/"owning-inputs")
cfg["storage"]["site_dir"]=str(ROOT/("test-site-"+stage))
cfg["run_status_file"]=str(ROOT/("test-run-status-"+stage+".json"))
cfg["storage"]["run_status_file"]=str(ROOT/("test-run-status-"+stage+".json"))
manifest=json.loads((ROOT/"input-manifest.json").read_text())
tracked={p:hashlib.sha256((SOURCE/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
         for p in [*manifest["files"], *manifest["owning_suite_literal_inputs"], *manifest["retained_inputs"]] if (SOURCE/p).is_file()}
import pytest
class Results:
    def __init__(self):
        self.passed=[];self.failed=[];self.skipped=[];self.errors=[]
    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self,report):
        if report.when=="call" and report.passed:self.passed.append(report.nodeid)
        if report.failed:self.failed.append({"nodeid":report.nodeid,"when":report.when})
        if report.skipped:self.skipped.append(report.nodeid)
    def pytest_collectreport(self,report):
        if report.failed:self.errors.append(report.nodeid)
plugin=Results()
suites=["tests/test_ipo_hk_missing_copy.py","tests/test_ipo_hk_evidence.py"]
if stage=="after": suites = ["tests/test_ipo.py", "tests/test_ipo_prospectus_terms.py"] + suites
started=time.monotonic()
code=pytest.main(["-q","--tb=short",*suites],plugins=[plugin])
unchanged=all(hashlib.sha256((SOURCE/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha for p,sha in tracked.items())
result={"stage":stage,"exit_code":code,"passed":len(plugin.passed),"failed":plugin.failed,
        "skipped":plugin.skipped,"collection_errors":plugin.errors,"network_attempts":attempts,
        "source_files_unchanged_during_test":unchanged,"suites":suites,
        "seconds":round(time.monotonic()-started,3),
        "passed_by_suite":{suite:sum(item.startswith(suite+"::") for item in plugin.passed) for suite in suites}}
raw=(json.dumps(result,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n").encode()
(ROOT/("tests-"+stage+".json")).write_bytes(raw)
print("HK_IPO_TEST_RESULT "+json.dumps({**result,"failed_count":len(plugin.failed),
      "failed":plugin.failed[:8],"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
assert unchanged,"Test mutated a retained source input"
assert not attempts,"Native proof attempted a network call"
raise SystemExit(code)
